correctness.rationale: Under exact renewal-age mixture definition, Tonelli and beta/gamma integration yield every even moment. Digamma strict increase and elementary negative rational derivatives prove fourth and sixth standardized moment ratios strictly decreasing over every positive exponent; limits are 6 and 9/5. Uniqueness follows from continuity. High-precision rational-endpoint intervals bracket the fourth-moment zero between 1.14 and 1.15 and bound the sixth standardized moment strictly below 15 there, so sixth cumulant cannot vanish. checker.py separately integrates beta and exponential factors at eight exponents; numerical tests do not substitute for analytic uniqueness.

value.rationale: Fourth standardized moment is a natural scale-free measure of observed stationary packet shape. This theorem proves it identifies the physical porous-medium nonlinearity globally despite unknown Poisson age scale, and identifies the sole false Gaussian indication at fourth order, rigorously resolved by negative sixth cumulant. It gives a motivated complete parameter classification rather than an arbitrary sampled parameter slice; finite-sample statistical performance and trajectory-level dynamics remain outside scope.
